page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.14xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features 56 dedicated vCPUs and 56 physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The system architecture is x86_64, with a CPU cache configuration of 32 KB L1d, 1.0 MB L2, and 35 MB L3. The instance is equipped with 224.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and relies on a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, such as the stress-ng single-core CPU test of 1107.38 and Geekbench single-core score of 948.0, fall into the bottom 25% tier. Similarly, single-threaded operations like gzip compression at 19.05 GB/sec and bzip3 decompression at 7.54 GB/sec are weak to poor. Conversely, multi-core performance scales to average levels, as demonstrated by a stress-ng multi-core score of 40954.08, a Geekbench multi-core score of 9467.0, and a Passmark CPU score of 35028.65. Memory bandwidth remains stable in the middle 50% tier, with read-only large block speeds at 104.82 GB/sec and write speeds at 50.54 GB/sec.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance is suited for multi-threaded workloads that can leverage its 56 physical cores to overcome lower single-core speeds. Appropriate workloads include static web serving, software compilation, database operations, and multi-threaded decompression tasks, which all achieved average benchmark ratings. It also supports moderate LLM inference, processing 7B model prompts at 68.67 tokens/sec. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers high resource density for parallelized legacy x86_64 applications, though the lack of bundled local storage requires external block storage provisioning.
